name: @borjie/document-reconciliation
description: Cross-document fact reconciliation for mining estate paperwork (LP-26). Pure matchers (Levenshtein name, E164 phone, address Jaccard, date tolerance, amount), a fact-bag-builder, EML/MSG/M-PESA-SMS/QR extractors, a per-issuer layout fingerprint registry, per-field Platt confidence calibration, and a self-consistency vote. Pure + ports; no direct SDK. Ported + re-skinned from LITFIN document-intelligence.
